implementationDeclarations.fresnelNormal: our analytic bevel-territory normal is the geometry's baked shoulder/rim vertex normal (normalView) — the closest structure our frozen geometry offers to the Target's analytic bevel normal; declared, not tuned
implementationDeclarations.rimAnalogue: the Target's rim is smoothstep over its rounded-rect SDF x 0.11; our geometry has no such SDF — the rim is driven by the strongLensRim zone attribute x rimIntensity(0.11), additive white. Declared BEFORE code; the one structural analogue in System B.
implementationDeclarations.envSampleClamped: the HDR sample is clamped to a finite ceiling before the LERP so a hot texel cannot inject Inf/NaN; ceiling 16.0 (highlights cap far above the visible range, the guard changes no visible pixel)
implementationDeclarations.shellDefault: shellMode defaults to 'off' on the sourceExact route when System B is active; QA setShellMode restores it as the shell-only control
implementationDeclarations.interiorMixBoundLaw: at facing=1 Schlick is exactly F0, so the source law itself LERPs the interior by min(F0*envIntensity, envMaxMix) = min(0.045*1.93, 0.27) = 0.0868 — the interior is EXPECTED to move by up to ~9% mix toward the env; the declared tolerance below derives from this law, not from taste
implementationDeclarations.acesDeviationPreRegistered: the Target shows the env LERP through NO tone mapping (material toneMapped:false); our body is toneMapped under frozen ACES exposure 1.05. Env whites will compress slightly on our page relative to the Target's. This deviation is KNOWN and DIRECTIONAL (our whites read marginally darker); it must NOT be compensated by raising envIntensity or any other parameter — post-capture parameter edits are forbidden.

failureConditions: F1 WRONG LEVER: the System B lever (full B minus envMix=0, same page, same media) moves bw-split darkSideEdgeLuma by less than +6.0 OR bw-split whiteReflectionRatio by less than +0.008 — the mechanism does not reach the white band; stop, do not tune
F2 GRAYSCALE RINGING: candidate edge chroma on grayscale-step or bw-split exceeds Before (11.22 / 9.73) by more than +1.0 — System B added colour to achromatic media

F3 LUMINANCE DEPENDENCE UNMOVED: bw-split brightSideEdgeChroma does not fall below 20 (Before 26.05, Target 1.41) OR the dark/bright edge-luma ratio does not rise by at least +0.025 from Before's 0.161 toward the Target's 0.248
F4 EDGE CHROMA FLOOR: mean edge-chroma drop vs Before across {rgb-bars, cool-blue, warm-skin} is less than 8.0 points — the candidate must beat DOUBLE the entire 4.09-point O1 dispersion lever

F5 INTERIOR VIOLATION: on any scored asset, interiorSaturationMean or interiorLuminanceMean changes by more than 12% relative vs Before (the law bound is 8.68% mix at facing=1 plus curvature headroom) — global desaturation or brightness compensation
F6 PLATFORM DIVERGENCE: the sign of any primary movement (saturated edge-chroma drop, bw-split white lever, ringing change) differs on 390x844 or 844x390 vs desktop
F7 MEDIA-ONLY MOVED: media-only differs from pre-O2 by a single pixel (frozen deterministic media, same lane)
F8 LANE INTEGRITY: either blocking equivalence proof in laneMapping fails by a single pixel
F9 FROZEN REGRESSION: any §八 suite fails at the candidate build
F10 GUTTER INVASION: gutterInkRatio on bw-split or rgb-bars rises by more than 0.01 vs Before

F11 POINTER PATH UNSTABLE: across pointer left/rest/right (same media), the candidate's highlight centroid nx is not monotonic in the same direction as the Target's, or an adjacent-state jump exceeds 0.4 card widths

F12 NOT VISIBLY OBVIOUS: the same-media full-frame side-by-side does not read as an unmistakable step toward white studio glass WITHOUT zooming — judged on the recorded frames and stated plainly either way

bOnlyVsAPlusBRule.verbatimFromBrief: Retain A only if A+B: improves fringe width / fringe chroma versus B-only; does not reduce white reflection ratio; does not worsen Bright/Dark sign stability; does not worsen Mobile; does not alter Media-only; does not create colour ringing on grayscale media. Otherwise choose B-only and remove O1 System A from the accepted product path.
bOnlyVsAPlusBRule.operationalisation: fringe = fringeRB and fringeWidthPxMean on {rgb-bars, cool-blue, warm-skin}; white = whiteReflectionRatio on {bw-split, grayscale-step}; bright/dark = F3's two measurands; mobile = the same metrics at 390x844/844x390; media-only = pixel diff; ringing = F2's measurands. 'Improves' and 'worsens' are strict inequalities on same-media same-page numbers; ties go to B-only.
